prompt: I've got a few hours free and want to build something useful for this ecosystem. What single feature or improvement would have the biggest impact right now? I'm comfortable with TypeScript and React.

assertions.name: recommends-lmeval
assertions.description: Response recommends LMEval or LMEval-adjacent work as the highest-impact choice

assertions.name: explains-why-highest-impact
assertions.description: Response explains WHY the recommendation has the biggest impact — references unblocking other projects or the refinement loop

assertions.name: suggests-specific-work
assertions.description: Response suggests specific features or areas of work, not just generic advice

assertions.name: no-pidog-as-priority
assertions.description: Response does NOT suggest PiDog projects as the most impactful use of time
